solar.title: Questionnaire for Climate Risk and Resilience Assessment of India’s Power Sector
solar.introduction: Please answer the following questions based on your observations and experience in the solar power generation sector. Your responses will help assess how climate-related stresses affect solar power plants and identify appropriate measures to strengthen their resilience and reliability.
solar.note: Note: The assessment focuses on the solar power plant as a whole, rather than on individual equipment or equipment-level details.

questions.text: At what ambient temperature does thermal derating typically begin in a solar power plant?
Above the thermal derating threshold, what is the typical reduction in power output for every 1°C increase in ambient temperature?
What is the maximum thermal derating typically allowed before the solar power plant enters protective shutdown or ceases generation?
For each high-temperature resilience measure below, estimate the implementation cost and provide the expected reduction in temperature-related  generation loss in solar power plant.
At what ambient temperature does low-temperature derating typically begin in a solar power plant?
Below the low-temperature derating threshold, what is the typical reduction in power output for every 1°C decrease in ambient temperature?
What is the maximum low-temperature derating typically observed before the solar power plant enters protective shutdown or ceases generation?
For each low-temperature resilience measure below, estimate the implementation cost and provide the expected reduction in generation losses in solar power plants.
At what daily rainfall threshold does the solar power plant typically begin to experience derating?
Once the rainfall threshold is exceeded, what is the typical reduction in generation for every additional 10 mm/day increase in rainfall?
During an extreme rainfall event, what is the maximum reduction in solar power generation or plant availability typically observed?
For each rainfall resilience measure below, estimate the implementation cost and provide the expected reduction in rainfall-related generation losses in solar power plants.
At what sustained wind speed does the solar power plant typically begin to experience derating or controlled power limitation?
Above the wind derating threshold, what is the typical reduction in power output for every 1 m/s increase in wind speed?
What is the maximum reduction in power output typically observed due to wind stress before or during protective shutdown?
For each wind stress resilience measure below, estimate the implementation cost and provide the expected reduction in wind stress-related generation losses.
What would be the estimated probability of significant operational, electrical, or structural failure in solar power plants for the following flood inundation depths: I1 and I2?
Following a flood-induced solar power plant failure or disruption, what restoration time is typically required before the solar power plant can resume normal operation?
Following a flood-induced protective shutdown without major physical damage, what restoration time is typically required before the solar power plant can resume normal operation?
For each flood-resilience measure below, estimate the implementation cost and provide the expected reduction in flood-related failure risk.
What is the estimated probability of significant operational, electrical, or structural failure in a solar power plant at cyclone intensities I1 and I2?
Following cyclone-induced structural or major electrical failure, what restoration time is typically required before the solar power plant can resume normal operation?
Following a cyclone-induced protective shutdown without major physical damage, what restoration time is typically required before the solar power plant can resume normal operation?
For each cyclone-resilience measure below, estimate the implementation cost and provide the expected reduction in cyclone-related failure risk.
What would be the estimated probability of significant operational, electrical, or structural failure for the following landslide events: low-intensity event and high-intensity event?
Following landslide-induced structural or major electrical failure, what restoration time is typically required before the solar power plant can resume normal operation?
Following a landslide-induced protective shutdown without major physical damage, what restoration time is typically required before the solar power plant can resume normal operation?
For each landslide-resilience measure below, estimate the implementation cost, and provide the expected reduction in landslide-related failure risk.

solar.respondentInstruction: Please provide your name, organization, and contact information.
